_mock_note: Hand-written mock for contract section 9. The Verifier is plain Python, not an LLM - an LLM checking an LLM can hallucinate agreement, which is worse than no check because we would trust it. tools/verify_mocks.py already contains a working reference implementation of this logic. status is 'pass', 'pass_after_retry' or 'fail'. suitability_flags are separate from unverified_numbers: a flag means the number is real but the plan is unsuitable, which is the Verifier doing risk work rather than arithmetic work.
